tasks.summary_pl: Ciągi arytm. i geom. powiązane: podaj $a_1+r+b_1+q$
tasks.statement_en: The sequence $(a_n)$ is arithmetic, and the sequence $(b_n)$ is geometric. The first term $a_1$ of the arithmetic sequence equals the common ratio of the geometric sequence $(b_n)$. The terms of $(a_n)$ are integers, and the sum of the first eight terms of this sequence is 124. The first term $b_1$ of the geometric sequence equals the common difference of the arithmetic sequence $(a_n)$. The sum of the first two terms of the geometric sequence $(b_n)$ is 18. Determine these sequences (sum of the four parameters $a_1+r+b_1+q$).
tasks.notes: Answer consists of two sequence formulas (a_n=3n+2, b_n=3*5^(n-1)); value is the sum of the four defining constants.

tasks.summary_en: Trapezoid in circle, leg 6, base 12. Area of incircle of $ABP$
tasks.statement_en: An isosceles trapezoid ABCD with leg length 6 is inscribed in a circle, where the longer base AB of the trapezoid, of length 12, is a diameter of this circle. The diagonals AC and BD of the trapezoid intersect at point P. Compute the area of the circle inscribed in triangle ABP.

tasks.notes: Wykaz, ze P(A\B)=3*P(B\A) - proof, though values are computable (0.3 and 0.1).
